# Pricing tool

## Requirements

- Every change to a pricing rule must be approved by two finance managers under Policy FIN-12.
- Price changes must be logged with the author's name under Policy FIN-14.

## Stories

- As a pricing analyst, I want to edit a pricing rule so that I can react to a competitor.
- As a pricing analyst, I want to preview the effect of a rule on the catalogue so that I avoid surprises.
- As a finance manager, I want to see a list of current rules so that I know what is live.
- As an auditor, I want each price change recorded with who made it so that I can review them.
